project.title: Warehouse Move & Office Records Consolidation
project.objective: Plan and execute a warehouse re-layout and office records consolidation to reduce handling time and improve document access without disrupting daily operations.
deliverables: Detailed warehouse re-layout and loading plan
Standard operating procedure for loading, unloading and stacking
Consolidated and indexed archive of paper and digital office records
Updated inventory of equipment, furniture and office supplies
Safety and handling checklist for movers and office staff
constraints: All moves must occur outside peak operating hours
No damage or loss of customer goods or records
Compliance with safety rules for lifting and dangerous goods
Limited access to forklifts and moving equipment during day shifts
Paper records must respect data protection and confidentiality rules

risks.risk: Damage to goods or office equipment during moving and stacking.
risks.mitigation: Use standard packing and stacking checklist, assign experienced movers to high-risk loads, and run a short training refresh.

risks.risk: Loss or misplacement of confidential documents during consolidation.
risks.mitigation: Label all boxes, maintain a transfer log, restrict access to archives, and digitise critical files first.

risks.risk: Operational downtime if move overlaps with busy periods.
risks.mitigation: Plan moves in small batches, schedule around peak hours, and get sign-off from warehouse supervisor for each batch.

risks.risk: Incorrect loading sequence causing delays in outbound shipments.
risks.mitigation: Pre-define loading sequences in a shared sheet and have movers confirm against the plan before loading.

themes.theme: Safe handling and stacking of goods
themes.why_relevant: Movers must reorganise stock and furniture without incidents or damage.
Office clerks will handle and digitise sensitive records during consolidation.
Physical moves and records work must align to avoid blocking each other.
Moves must not disrupt daily shipments, deliveries or office work.
New SOPs and checklists will reduce errors in future moves and archiving.

backlog.task: Map current warehouse layout and identify high-priority zones for re-layout
definition_of_done: All aisles and storage zones sketched or photographed
High-turnover and dangerous goods zones clearly marked
List of current pain points agreed in channel

backlog.task: Draft proposed warehouse re-layout and loading sequence guidelines
definition_of_done: New layout zones defined with clear access paths
Loading and unloading sequence documented for typical routes
Warehouse supervisor feedback captured for adjustments

backlog.task: Create inventory of office records and supplies to be moved or digitised
definition_of_done: All filing cabinets and storage rooms listed
Boxes of records tagged with content type and date range
Office supplies stock counted and logged in shared sheet

backlog.task: Define confidentiality and handling rules for paper and digital records
definition_of_done: Access levels defined for each record category
Simple guideline written and shared in channel
Stakeholders confirm rules meet data protection requirements

backlog.task: Plan move schedule for warehouse zones and office areas
definition_of_done: Time windows agreed for each zone and office area
Schedule avoids peak operational hours
Movers and office staff confirm resource availability

backlog.task: Prepare packing, stacking and lifting safety checklist for movers
definition_of_done: Checklist covers lifting limits, stacking height and dangerous goods
Reviewed by health and safety officer
Posted in channel and printed for warehouse use

backlog.task: Set up a simple tracking log for boxes, pallets and archive cartons
definition_of_done: Log format created in shared sheet
Unique IDs defined for each box or pallet
Movers trained on how to update the log during moves

backlog.task: Pilot move of one warehouse zone and one office archive section
definition_of_done: Selected zone and archive section moved according to schedule
No incidents or missing items reported
Lessons learned documented in channel

backlog.task: Digitise priority documents and update digital filing structure
definition_of_done: Priority document types agreed and listed
Scanned files stored in correct folders with clear names
Index updated so staff can find digitised records quickly

backlog.task: Update equipment and furniture inventory after re-layout
definition_of_done: All major equipment and furniture items listed with new locations
Any damaged items recorded and reported
Inventory sheet shared with warehouse and office managers

backlog.task: Review and finalise standard operating procedure for future moves
definition_of_done: Draft SOP compiled from checklists and lessons learned
Movers and office staff review and comment
Final version approved and stored in shared drive

backlog.task: Train team on new layout, procedures and safety rules
definition_of_done: Short briefing session held for each shift
Attendance recorded in channel
Key questions and clarifications documented

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, roles and initial warehouse and office mapping tasks.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the warehouse re-layout and records consolidation project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which warehouse zones and office areas are in scope for this phase.
Agree who owns updates to the layout plan and the records inventory log.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the move schedule and resource plan across shifts.
threads_plan.trigger: Need to lock dates and time windows for moving priority zones and archives.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final move schedule for each warehouse zone and office area.
Decide how many movers and office clerks are assigned per move batch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in safety, stacking and confidentiality rules before the pilot move.
threads_plan.trigger: Preparation for the first pilot move of one warehouse zone and one archive section.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the safety checklist for lifting, stacking and dangerous goods.
Confirm confidentiality rules for handling and digitising records during moves.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot move results and adjust layout, schedule and logs.
threads_plan.trigger: Completion of the pilot move and initial feedback from movers and office staff.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which changes to apply to the layout plan and move schedule after the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Close out the project with final SOP, training recap and next steps.
threads_plan.trigger: All main moves completed and inventories updated, ready for formal closure.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the final move SOP and agree how it will be maintained.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts what they will move or update that day.
Twice-weekly schedule review to adjust move batches based on operations load.
Post-pilot debrief thread to capture issues, near misses and quick fixes.
End-of-week summary message listing completed tasks and upcoming priorities.
